pages.title: Ministry of Digital Governance (Greece) - Wikipedia
pages.excerpt: The**Ministry of Digital Governance**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Ψηφιακής Διακυβέρνησης)[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Administrative_Reform_and_e-Governance_(Greece)#cite_note-1)is a[government department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))of[Greece](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece). It was initially formed on 27 June 2011 as the**Ministry of Administrative Reform and Electronic Governance**(Υπουργείο Διοικητικής Μεταρρύθμισης και Ηλεκτρονικής Διακυβέρνησης). On 27 January 2015, it was merged with the[Ministry of the Interior](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_the_Interior_(Greece))and the[Ministry of Public Order and Citizen Protection](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Citizen_Protection_(Greece))to form the Ministry of the Interior and Administrative Reorganization (Υπουργείο Εσωτερικών και Διοικητικής Ανασυγκρότησης).
